mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of instances where UNRATE declines, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.3% indicates monetary tightening, which may reduce borrowing and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases above 0.3%, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand, which should drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST increase, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals increased economic activity, which should drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of instances where INDPRO increases, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, which should drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of instances where GDPC1 increases, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a strong labor market, which should drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of instances where PAYEMS grows by more than 0.5%, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a potential mismatch between monetary policy and economic activity, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and RSAFS increase, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) during a period of economic expansion indicates weakening demand, which should drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of instances where HOUST declines during expansion, this hypothesis is rejected.
